about_the_game:
A LITTLE BIT OF 8-BIT is a music pack that features a "musical recipe" that marries the retro vibe of classic game music with the new tunes of fresh musical compositions. It can musically power game projects with a "neo-nostalgic musical atmosphere" !

It's a fresh musical experience that pays tribute to the classics while also sounding new.

■ It's not quite a nostalgia... it's more a like a New-stalgia!

A LITTLE BIT OF 8-BIT revisits classic nostalgic tunes - without sounding "too nostalgic". It features newly-composed game music with "just a little bit of 8-bit musical seasoning".

■ Retro + Modern - in a single "neo-nostalgic package"!

This "specialized musical experiment" integrates classic accents with new compositions. Hence, it can ideally fit both retro-themed and modern-styled video game projects.

■ New Tunes with Classic Vibes

The musical compositions are entirely new - while also having "that good old classic vibe".

■ Exclusive Extras

This neo-retro musical package also features two (2) Exclusive Extra BGM Soundtracks!

If you've been looking for classic retro game music - that does not sound too classic…

If you want fresh game music with just the right amount of classic retro elements …

Then a "reasonable balance of retro and modern sounds" could be the answer.

Maybe your game's musical personality just needs ..A LITTLE BIT OF 8-BIT !

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

【Musical Content Outline / ESSENTIAL SPECS】

・ 8 Main Musical Soundtracks

・ Exclusive "Maker Extra" : 2 BGM Soundtracks

・ Total Number of BGM Tracks: 10

【Musical Track List / DETAILED SPECS】

1. August Is Not September – 3:56

2. Just Cruisin' Along – 1:35

3. MEMO RIZ – 4:13

4. Robo Rebel – 3:34

5. The Spirit of Curious Adventure – 3:18

6. Sunday MayDay – 2:09

7. What If The Moon Was The Sun – 5:44

8. Yes, Your Beautyness! – 3:02

9. What What Should Should I Do – 1:50 ( Exclusive Extra )

10. Stealth Zone – 1:22 ( Exclusive Extra )

Available in RPG Maker-Ready Audio Formats

------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
